_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Special Packaging Instructions (SPI)
summary: This DID specifies the content and format for submitting Special Packaging Instructions resulting from the packaging work task described in MIL-STD-2073-1.
use_relationship:
This Data Item Description (DID) specifies the content and format for submitting Special Packaging Instructions (SPI). This DID identifies the format and content preparation instructions for Special Packaging Instructions resulting from the work task described by 4.1 of MIL-STD-2073-1. This data applies to all special group items as defined in MIL-STD-2073-1. When Special Packaging Instructions are required, DI-PACK-80120 Preservation and Packaging Data also applies.
When the SPI applies to packaging of hazardous materials (except those materials excluded by United Nations Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods as implemented by the International Civil Aviation Organization and the International Maritime Organization Regulations), DI-PACK-81059 Performance Oriented Packaging (POP) Test report applies.
This DID contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data product resulting from the work task described in the contract SOW.
This DID supersedes DI-PACK-80121C.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

Unless otherwise specified, all referenced documents are available from the Acquisition Streamlining and Standardization Information System (ASSIST) at https://assist.dla.mil.

children.title: Special Packaging Instructions format.
children.content: SPI content and format shall be in accordance with Appendix E of MIL-STD-2073-1.
